layers.message: Record project context, scope, and design for report --since

prompt.utterance: I want to withdraw the implementation-reviewed completion choice.

graderOnly: The implementation review (COMPLETE), the FULL verification report (COMPLETE), and the ELIGIBLE Implementation-Reviewed Closure assessment all remain current: no project file changed after the commits they assessed.
No normal Documenter, final-review, or synchronization work has begun: no documentation record, final-deliverable review, or synchronization record exists for the cycle.
README.md does not yet describe --since; that is ordinary Documenter work once the full-deliverable tail resumes, not something the withdrawal itself should perform.

The correct result is CompletionPolicy FULL_DELIVERABLE, WorkflowState DOCUMENTING, Handoff COMPLETION_CHANGE from AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF with FailureType NONE, no recovery frame, the Request's policy instruction replaced, review and verification records untouched, then a Documenter invocation and a stop.

all.why: the handoff reason names both the old and the new policy
existing records, including the review report's historical closure assessment, are preserved

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Reviewer does not edit implementation or tests

selfChecks.why: the verified and reviewed test suite passes on the committed implementation
AC-002 behavior: an invalid --since date exits non-zero with an error

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project: small Node ESM CLI (timesheet report) committed before install. 50-planning: CONTEXT.md, scope (AC-001..AC-003), design, STATE at DEVELOPING with CompletionPolicy IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEWED and the user's choice and reason recorded in Active Work.Request. 60-implementation: --since filter, src/args.js, CLI tests, COMPLETE development plan, STATE at TESTING. 70-verification: COMPLETE FULL verification report citing the implementation commit, STATE at REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION. 80-review: COMPLETE implementation review with an ELIGIBLE Implementation-Reviewed Closure section, STATE at AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF (FORWARD from REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION). No blockers, recovery, obligations, pending cadence, or baseline reconciliation. No documentation, final review, or synchronization record exists. After a correct run, check still passes: COMPLETION_CHANGE AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF -> DOCUMENTING is a valid route and the implementation review remains COMPLETE.
